scope: Synthetic, semantically equivalent source shapes chosen after a compiler survey. These test transformation discovery, not general matching efficiency.

cases.name: branch_inversion
cases.base: int f(int a,int b,int c) {int x; x=a+b; if(a<0){x^=c;}else{x+=c;} return x;}
cases.target: int f(int a,int b,int c) { int x; x=a+b; if (!(a<0)) {x+=c;} else {x^=c;} return x;}

cases.name: barrier_placement
cases.base: int f(int a,int b,int c) {int x; x=a+b; if(a<0){x^=c;}else{x+=c;} return x;}
cases.target: int f(int a,int b,int c) {int x; x=a+b; __asm__ volatile(""); if(a<0){x^=c;}else{x+=c;} return x;}

cases.name: temporary_materialization
cases.base: int f(int *p,int a,int b) {int x; int y; x=p[0]+a; y=p[1]+b; if(x<y){p[2]=x;return y-x;}else{p[2]=y;return x+y;}}
cases.target: int f(int *p,int a,int b) {int x; int y; {int temp; temp=p[0]+a; x=temp;} y=p[1]+b; if(x<y){p[2]=x;return y-x;}else{p[2]=y;return x+y;}}

cases.name: combined_branch_and_temporary
cases.base: int f(int *p,int a,int b) {int x; int y; x=p[0]+a; y=p[1]+b; if(x<y){p[2]=x;return y-x;}else{p[2]=y;return x+y;}}
cases.target: int f(int *p,int a,int b) {int x; int y; {int temp; temp=p[0]+a; x=temp;} y=p[1]+b; if(!(x<y)){p[2]=y;return x+y;}else{p[2]=x;return y-x;}}
